title: Run the whitespace-only check locally against a fetched base branch
answers: how do I run the whitespace check locally
local whitespace check against upstream master
body:
Command: `uv run --no-project dev/check_whitespace_only.py --repo mlflow/mlflow --pr <N> --base-revision upstream/master`.
--base-revision is required (no default). Use a revision that exists in your clone, e.g. upstream/master after `git fetch upstream master`; a missing ref makes git diff fail.
The diff is computed from your local HEAD, so check out the PR branch first; the diff is not fetched from GitHub.
GitHub is queried for PR labels only when whitespace-only changes are detected (get_pr_labels), so the --repo and --pr flags matter only in that case.
CI uses `--base-revision HEAD^1` (see .github/workflows/lint.yml).
applies: Developers or agents running dev/check_whitespace_only.py outside CI.
says: Local whitespace check fails because the upstream target branch has not been fetched

Detect formatting-only changes locally so pull requests receive the appropriate label automatically
